 Item 5.02. Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of
Certain Officers. 
 On November 2, 2026, Linnie M. Haynesworth notified the
Governance and Sustainability Committee of the Board of Directors (the “Board”) of Micron Technology, Inc. (the “Company”)
that she would retire from the Board and, accordingly, Ms. Haynesworth will not be nominated for re-election at the Company’s
fiscal 2026 annual shareholders meeting (the “Annual Meeting”). Ms. Haynesworth will continue to serve as a director
through the end of her term at the Annual Meeting.
